appValue.executive: See the whole factory on one screen before you decide.
appValue.commercial: From enquiry to confirmed order, no customer slips through.
appValue.merchandising: Get consumption right up front, not after the fabric is cut.
appValue.planning: Know which line has capacity before promising a ship date.
appValue.production: Hourly output shows a line falling behind before the order is late.
appValue.quality: AQL 2.5 inspection — every defect has evidence and an owner.
appValue.warehouse: Know exactly how much fabric is left before releasing a cut order.
appValue.shipment: Cartons match the documents, so containers do not sit at the port.
appValue.subcontract: External workshops report daily; goods sent out are never lost track of.
appValue.finance: Costing and payables trace back to source documents, not to memory.
appValue.humanResources: Attendance tied to the real output of each line.
appValue.reporting: Every figure opens the document that produced it.
appValue.communication: Conversations live beside the order, not lost in a chat group.
appValue.ai: Ask in plain language; answers come from the factory’s real data.
appValue.documents: The right tech pack version — nobody sews from an old one.
appValue.platform: Access follows the assignment — revocable and auditable.
